en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of two women dressed in traditional, loose-fitting garments, likely haiks, and veils walking outdoors on a sunny path with lush, possibly tropical or Mediterranean, foliage in the background. The image has a vintage, early 20th-century aesthetic. At the bottom, there is a printed caption in French: '1226 Mauresques en Promenade'.
